Class FightTrace

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.client.FightTrace
final class FightTrace extends Object
A training fight against a scripted opponent, tick by tick, for reading afterwards how a fight was lost: the distance, both swords (the opponent's as the server has it), who is on the ground and how the opponent is moving, the keys and which rule pressed them, the tactic, and every hit either way with whether it was critical. One small gzipped text file a fight in swordai/traces, named with the time, the kind of opponent, the seed, W or L and the damage either way; only the newest KEPT are kept. On with Config.traceFights. The user, 22 October: "read the cases it loses yourself and pretend if you were the player how do you counter it".
